summary:
Short retest of iteration 13's 3 minor follow-ups. (1) Markdown stripping: unit tests of split_show pass. It removes **, __ and '# ' headings, and turns '* ' or '- ' at line start into '• '. Text mid-line ('10-15$', '3 * 2', 'Price - 5$', 'C# #1', '-5$', '*note') is left as is. catalog_text has the no-markdown rule. Live LLM tests on the loadtest business with 6 products passed 4/4: 'What do you sell?', 'បងលក់អ្វីខ្លះ?', 'list all products with prices' and /api/ai/test. No reply had **, [[show or markdown list markers, and every reply had at least 5 of the 6 products attached. (2) Telegram album fallback: with httpx mocked, when sendMediaGroup returns 400 or 500 the photo captions are sent as one sendMessage, with the captions of products without images added after them (P0 — 0$
P1 — 1$
T0
T1). This also works with voice. A 200 album sends no fallback. The iteration 13 deliver unit tests still pass (15/15 unit tests in total). (3) Product cards UI checked with Playwright in the Embed widget, Settings AI test box and Inbox, at 1920 and 390 widths, with 6 products and with 1 product. Cards show in a 2-column grid with square images (170px, or 148px in Settings at 390). Page width overflow is 0 everywhere, no element sticks out to the right, and names/prices are readable. Products without an image show the ImageOff placeholder. Cleanup: loadtest products deleted (0 left) and TEST_/UI web conversations deleted. Admin's Gemini Pro was not touched.

minor.issue:
With re.M, '^\s*[*-]\s+' can also match newlines, so it removes the blank line before a list: 'Here you go:

- A' becomes 'Here you go:
• A'. It also removes the indentation of nested items. Only cosmetic. Fix: use '^[ 	]*[*-][ 	]+(?=\S)'.

Only a non-200 sendMediaGroup has a fallback. If a single-product sendPhoto fails, or an httpx exception happens during the album, the product name/price is never sent (the exception goes to the outer except). Low priority.

issues: The product grid is a fixed w-[22rem] box inside a justify-end row, so 1 product card sits in the left column of that box. It does not line up with the right edge of the AI bubble (at 1920: card right edge 1159px vs bubble 1306px). Consider justify-items-end / 'ml-auto' for single cards, or grid-cols-1 w-44 when products.length===1.
6 products fill about 700px of height (3 rows of 220px cards). Fine, but smaller cards or a horizontal scroll row would make long catalogs easier to read on phones. Optional.

action_items: Optional: change MARKDOWN list pattern to '^[ \t]*[*-][ \t]+(?=\S)' so blank lines before lists are kept
Optional: add a text fallback when single sendPhoto fails or the album request raises
Optional: align single product card to the right under AI bubbles in Inbox
critical_code_review_comments: MARKDOWN regex '\s*' after '^' with re.M crosses line breaks (see minor issue)
deliver(): no fallback for sendPhoto failure or exception paths
